name: Dunecrest
summary: A loan management app in warm sand glass over a drawn desert house, with an hourglass calculator
about: A complete loan management app for a private lender or a property finance team. Warm sand-coloured glass floats over a drawn desert house at golden hour (or dusk in the dark theme), with neon lime for the live bits. It has loans with full repayment schedules, a drag-and-drop application pipeline, borrowers with documents, a repayment calendar, collections with payment plans, and a calculator where an hourglass drains as you scrub through the loan.
how: Open a loan to see its schedule, the hourglass of what is repaid, and record a payment
Drag applications from Applied to Funded, or use a card's ••• menu; funding creates a new loan
Click a day in the Due calendar to see who pays, and move between months
Log a call or start a payment plan for late loans on the Arrears page
Drag the sliders in the calculator and scrub through the months to watch the sand fall
Switch the loan book chart between 6M, 12M and 24M, and export reports as CSV
